svg.title: Campus Cards · Set 06 · Merced · 06/12 Cattle on the Range (Uncommon)
svg.desc: Cattle graze the open rangeland near campus. They keep the grass short and rarely look up. Unofficial. An independent PointCast art project about places. Not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by the University of California or any campus. No university logos, seals, mascots, or marks are used.
